items.title: Hegseth ousts Pentagon’s chief planner as renewed action against Iran looms, source says
items.brief: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has pushed out the Pentagon’s top planning officer as President Donald Trump weighs new strikes against Iran, a source familiar with the situation tells CNN.

items.title: Dolores Huerta, pioneering labor leader and civil rights icon, dies at 96
items.brief: Dolores Huerta, a pioneering labor organizer and civil rights icon who cofounded the United Farm Workers with Cesar Chavez in the 1960s, died at 96, her family said in a statement Wednesday.

items.title: Election Day storm could impact voter turnout in key midterm races in the central US
items.brief: A soggy storm will track through the central United States on Election Day and could influence voter turnout for key races in the region .

items.title: The Vatican unveils its holy garage of popemobiles used since 1930
items.brief: The Vatican is opening a celebration of the popemobile, the now-iconic vehicle that for nearly a century has let popes get close to the faithful at home and abroad.
